DOCOS → HARDEN: 4 provider route faults from design-lap. Self-contained evidence pushed at 28b1d43b8: plans/reports/debug-261106-2221-provider-route-faults-gemini-argon-agy-account-flag.md (versions, invocations, log lines quoted).
1) omp gemini-4-argon 404 when launched with PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=<profile>/agent (fgOS's launch shape); interactive omp --profile works in the same minute, but print mode with --profile also 404'd 6/6, so cause is open; fgOS leaves omp idle after an on-screen 404 until timeout; probe-account tests only the default Flash model, not the seat's flagship.
2) agy 1.5.2 over herdr: brief lands in the input box, never submitted; start screen shows a new 'Changes to third-party model access ... esc to dismiss' banner (p-a178ca5c fixed the 1.4.2 banner; the readiness check misses the new one or skips config-declared agy invocations).
3) workflow start --account gemini/tetnu moved the framing seat to gemini (openai in the other 4 runs); the lease then chose the omp-herdr route for an account with only an agy login.
4) pi/deepseek seat: OpenRouter 402 (pi asks ~914,824 max tokens, same as p-d2dc4f2e), visible only in the pane; fgOS note says 'grant trust' (wrong fix); no fallback launch tried (4 of 16 used); one dead seat failed the whole synthesis step.
A same-minute A/B of fault 1 on fg-server2 would settle its cause. Earlier omp foreground report: debug-261106-1557-omp-update-banner-seat-foreground-not-agent.md.
